title: A Menswork website's admin pages wear the site's own header and menu, with a blue admin row marked admin view only in place of the Admin button

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-08: 'Let's keep the same header / menu through the site. Instead of an admin button. make it a double menu with admin settings in blue. Leave a note about admin view only.'

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-08. The website's /admin pages (LIVE-864) render inside the site's own chrome (site-chrome.tsx): header and menu, season bar, footer, through siteChromeBasics in site-page.tsx, so the menu is the same on every page. Under the header a second row in the theme's blue (site-admin-bar.tsx) holds the tag 'Admin view only', the Executive Overview and Yearly Calendar, a labelled 'Manage on Frequency' link to the console Leadership page, and the note 'Visitors never see this menu.' The visitor menu and phone menu lose the Admin item; a quiet Admin link in the footer is the way in. The admin pages draw the row on the server; the cached public pages draw it client side only when the browser holds the readable hint cookie the site's handoff sets beside the httpOnly pass (lib/sites/site-admin-hint.ts), so a visitor's page never shows it and the cached HTML is the same for everyone. The admin pages pin their rails under the 105px header (--hfa-top). AMENDED 2026-10-08 (LIVE-869, owner asks 'Menu should read: Home | The Year | Circles | Calendar | Retreat | About (Blue after this) | ADMIN: Executive Overview' and 'Add blue admin section to the footer as well'): the separate admin row, its hint cookie and the quiet footer link are gone; the admin pages still wear the site's own header and menu, whose blue admin links mark the page they are on.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];if(!/<SiteChrome/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/admin/[view]/page.tsx')))miss.push('the admin pages do not wear the site header');if(!/siteAdminLinks\(chrome\.origin, space\.slug, '', view\)/.test(r('app/hosted/[host]/admin/[view]/page.tsx')))miss.push('the admin pages do not mark their page in the menu');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-868: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
